Exclusive Innovative Restaurant Robot

Multi-Function of BellaBot Can Meet the Demands of HORECA Management

Safety

In pursuit of higher safety, BellaBot is equipped with 3D sensors and a new modular chassis. It can stop at any angle and move away as soon as it encounters obstacles to ensure the safety of dinning area.

Multimodal Interaction

Bella has multimodal interaction function, including AI voice, light interaction, touch interaction and smart expressions. Cute Bella is always the most popular 'waitress' in restaurant!

Easy to use

BellaBot supports two SLAM navigation solutions simultaneously in order to adapt to more scenarios, both of which are accurate and easy to use. No need to install markers any more.

Improving Service Quality

How Does BellaBot Help Restaurant to Reduce Costs and Increase Efficiency?

Large Loads

BellaBot features a large tray (41×50cm), which allows for a single tray to provide twice the carrying capacity as a manual delivery.

More Deliveries

In restaurants, BellaBot can complete roughly 400 food and beverage deliveries every day, while a restaurant employee could deliver 200-300 dishes each day.

Coordination among Multiple Robots

BellaBot features a multi-robot delivery mode, which supports up to 20 BellaBot robots operating at the same time. BellaBot can easily handle any scenario from a small venue of a few hundred square meters to a space larger than ten thousand square meters.

95% Customer Satisfaction

How Does BellaBot Improve Customer Satisfaction?

Reduce food delivery
time and improve
service quality

BellaBot is responsible for food delivery, enabling waiters to focus on table service. She can improving customer satisfaction by spending more time on customer service (e.g. customer orientation and recommended dishes). In addition, she will be able to provide consistent service even during peak hours, thus increasing operational efficiency and improving customer service.

Multi-modal interaction provides customers with an unprecedented dining experience

Featuring an innovative bionic design language, cute modeling, AI voice functionality, multi-modal interaction and many other new functions, BellaBot provides users with an unprecedented food delivery robot experience.

Customer's service
satisfaction
exceeds 95%

By spending food delivery time on customer service, restaurants can provide more professional table service, such as detailed descriptions of dishes and meeting other customer needs. In the service-satisfaction survey about the use of BellaBot, about 95% of customers responded "satisfied" and no one responded "dissatisfied"
